end.summary:
Built and read food chains using arrows.
Explained energy flow from food to eater in examples.
Predicted that fish would lack food if larvae were removed.
Explained that dead leaves would break down slowly without earthworms.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Manav practised making food chains with arrows and explaining what happens when one living thing is removed. They correctly linked grass to deer, mango leaves to caterpillars, and algae to larvae to fish, and explained the energy flow. At home, ask Manav to draw one food chain and explain what changes if its middle link is removed.
